method: Editorial style quotas and source-coverage validation

basis.source: Student recollection of Exam 1 format; not a supplied exam or second-exam guide
basis.approach: Balanced lecture coverage with researcher-linked interpretation, experimental design, application, and concise relational distinctions. Distractors use confounds, reversed relationships, overclaims, and competing explanations.

prior_model_use: Retain lecture/source alignment and transparent reporting. Do not transfer Exam 1 chapter weights or six sample-question similarities to a new exam without its guide.
cumulative_allocation: Equal lecture quotas; a randomly assigned remainder keeps the total fixed.
